newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia SKB says GDRs trading in London.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia SKB says GDRs trading in London.

text.p: Slovenia's second largest bank SBK said on Thursday its global depositary receipts (GDRs) started trading on the London Stock Exchange on February 12.
"This is a step towards the further internationalisation of SKB bank and towards the development of the Slovenian capital market," the bank said in a statement.
SKB is the first Slovenian bank to be listed abroad.
Its GDRs represent 29 percent of the bank's equity and are traded on the SEAQ system of London Stock Exchange.
LSE admitted a total of 1.3 million GDRs, representing 65,000 ordinary shares. A total of $17.0 million was raised with the issue.
